The room rates are good.

The electricity does cut out when the generator is running, but the important thing is that it's continuous.

Their services are good. If you need them to pick up groceries, take your laundry, or order lunch, they'll deliver, but not from far away.
The reception staff are excellent and straightforward, and you have a landline to call them. However, once another employee answered the phone and was rude, not letting me finish my sentence and hanging up without bringing what I requested.

A mattress and pillow are provided.

Negatives:
The biggest problem I faced was the lack of room maintenance. Sometimes I found a broken plug, other times the shower leaked excessively, and the sink drain had a problem. The towel in the room was very old. I wasn't happy with the laundry; there were still stains and dust residue. However, the ironing was excellent.

First and foremost, the exorbitant prices, The Mariot Taiz Hotel is undeniably expensive, especially considering the subpar quality of the rooms. To my dismay, the rooms were incredibly small, leaving very little space for comfort or relaxation, This lack of space significantly impacted my overall experience and made it feel rather claustrophobic.

Another major inconvenience was the hotel's policy of charging extra for the use of air conditioning, it baffles me that such a necessity in a hot climate like Taiz is treated as an additional package; the discomfort of having to pay extra for a basic amenity like AC was truly unacceptable and tarnished my impression of the hotel.

Adding insult to injury, the decision to cover the bed mattresses with leather was nothing short of a nightmare, the leather covering not only made the beds uncomfortably hot but also disrupted my sleep further, It seemed like a deliberate ploy to compel guests to opt for the additional AC package, extracting more money from their wallets.

Moreover, the bathrooms were disappointingly small and devoid of any unique features, they lacked the elegance and charm that one would expect from a renowned luxury hotel like Mariot Taiz. It felt like stepping into an average, run-of-the-mill bathroom rather than a lavish accommodation.

One of the most frustrating aspects was the complicated system of using the elevator. The hotel utilized NFC cards that had to be carried along with the room key in order to access the elevator. This meant that if I wanted to go anywhere, even just to the first floor, I had to take the NFC card with me. As a result, the moment the NFC card left the rented room, the electricity would be abruptly cut off within ten seconds. This cumbersome process not only made it inconvenient for guests but also created unnecessary complications, especially when traveling with a partner.

All in all, my stay at the Mariot Taiz Hotel was far from satisfactory. The high prices, cramped rooms, additional charges for basic amenities, lackluster bathrooms, and hassle of using the elevator system profoundly affected my overall experience negatively. Overall, it was a decent 4-star experience that served our needs well, but a few significant maintenance and service issues kept it from being a perfect 5-star stay.

The Good:
The hotel is very quiet and convenient for travelers, situated in a location that made getting around easy. The rooms are impressively spacious, providing plenty of room to spread out, and are equipped with the bare necessities—exactly what we needed for a simple base. The peaceful atmosphere was a highlight, allowing for good rest. For the price point, the value was okay and met our basic expectations for a short trip.

The Not-So-Good:
Unfortunately, the maintenance and service left a bit to be desired and disrupted our stay.

Maintenance: We dealt with a leaking sink in the kitchen that was constant and annoying. Additionally, our keycards stopped working multiple times throughout the stay. It was quite a hassle to repeatedly walk back to the front desk to get them reset just to enter our room.

Service: The breakfast service was unreliable. On our second day, breakfast was never delivered at all. We called to follow up and waited over 45 minutes hoping it would arrive, but it never did, which delayed our morning plans.

It is located in Sana'a, the capital of Yemen, and is currently organized with 17 faculties. Previously the university was located at 15°20′53.16″N 44°11′26.83″E, and was built on the grounds of the old Jewish cemetery.

The university includes several accommodation buildings for staff and students and is partnered with the Kuwait University Hospital for medical students.[

When Sana'a university was first established, it had two faculties: the Faculty of Sharia and Law and the Faculty of Education, which also included the specialties of Colleges of Arts, Sciences and Education. In 1974, those specialties were developed and formed three new faculties: Arts, Science, Education. The Faculty of Sharia and Law celebrated the launch of the Business Department, which became an independent faculty a year later. By that time, the university included five faculties and continued expansion until it included the rest of the other specialties. As of 2005, Sana'a University was composed of twenty faculties with 12 faculties at the main campus of Sanaa and eight others at different branches throughout the country.
The university started postgraduate studies at the start of the 1980s

موقع الشلال:
يقع شلال المشنة في سفح جبل بعدان في نطاق مديرية المشنة وفي الجهة الشرقية من مدينة إب (مركز المحافظة)، وتغذيه ينابيع جبل بعدان بالمياه العذبة طوال العام، وتحيط به خضرة الجبال وجمال مدينة إب الآسرة.
مميزات الشلال:
* يعتبر الشلال من أجمل المواقع السياحية في محافظة إب، حيث يتميز بمناظره الطبيعية الخلابة وهدير الماء المتدفق من ارتفاع شاهق.

* يقصده المئات من الزائرين من أبناء المحافظة وزوارها، طوال أيام العام، وفي موسم الأمطار بشكل خاص يتحول المكان إلى مزار مكتظ بالزائرين.
* يوفر الشلال للزائرين فرصة الاستمتاع بمناظره الطبيعية الخلابة، والاسترخاء على أصوات هدير الماء، وممارسة الأنشطة الترفيهية المختلفة مثل التنزه والمشي والتخييم.
* يعتبر الشلال مصدر رزق للعشرات من السكان المحليين، حيث تنتشر في محيطه العديد من الأكشاك والمحلات التي تبيع المأكولات والمشروبات والهدايا التذكارية.
كيف تصل إلى شلال المشنه:
يمكن الوصول إلى شلال المشنة من مدينة إب بسهولة، حيث يبعد عنها حوالي 15 كيلومترًا. يمكن الوصول إلى الشلال بالسيارة أو الدراجة النارية أو الحافلة.
نصائح عند زيارة شلال المشنه:
* احرص على ارتداء ملابس وأحذية مريحة مناسبة للمشي.
* خذ معك قبعة ونظارات شمسية، خاصة في فصل الصيف.
* احمل معك كمية كافية من الماء والوجبات الخفيفة.
* احترم البيئة الطبيعية للمنطقة، ولا تترك وراءك أي نفايات.

* أفضل وقت لزيارة شلال المشنة هو في فصل الربيع أو الخريف، حيث تكون درجات الحرارة معتدلة والأجواء جميلة.
* يوجد في محيط الشلال العديد من المطاعم والمقاهي التي تقدم المأكولات والمشروبات اليمنية التقليدية.
* يمكنك الاستمتاع برحلة إلى الشلال مع أحد المرشدين السياحيين المحليين، الذين سيطلعونك على تاريخ المنطقة ومعالمها.","Images":null,"When":"a year ago","review_id":"Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21wd2JrTmFhSFYwYVhsd2JYVlNRMmhaU2s4M1NYYxAB","source":"Google","rating_scale":5,"rating_float":5,"author_url":"https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/113677349063971097865/reviews?hl=en-US","posted_at_unix_micros":1750768857318951,"updated_at_unix_micros":1750768857318951,"language":"ar","translated_lang":"en","text_original":"شلال المشنه في محافظة إب الجمهورية اليمنية:

Al-Mashna Waterfall is located at the foot of Mount Ba'dan, within the Al-Mashna District, east of Ibb City (the governorate's capital). It is fed by the springs of Mount Ba'dan, which provide fresh water year-round, and is surrounded by the lush greenery of the mountains and the captivating beauty of Ibb City.

It is located in Sana'a, the capital of Yemen, and is currently organized with 17 faculties. Previously the university was located at 15°20′53.16″N 44°11′26.83″E, and was built on the grounds of the old Jewish cemetery.

The university includes several accommodation buildings for staff and students and is partnered with the Kuwait University Hospital for medical students.[

When Sana'a university was first established, it had two faculties: the Faculty of Sharia and Law and the Faculty of Education, which also included the specialties of Colleges of Arts, Sciences and Education. In 1974, those specialties were developed and formed three new faculties: Arts, Science, Education. The Faculty of Sharia and Law celebrated the launch of the Business Department, which became an independent faculty a year later. By that time, the university included five faculties and continued expansion until it included the rest of the other specialties. As of 2005, Sana'a University was composed of twenty faculties with 12 faculties at the main campus of Sanaa and eight others at different branches throughout the country.
The university started postgraduate studies at the start of the 1980s

It is located in Sana'a, the capital of Yemen, and is currently organized with 17 faculties. Previously the university was located at 15°20′53.16″N 44°11′26.83″E, and was built on the grounds of the old Jewish cemetery.

The university includes several accommodation buildings for staff and students and is partnered with the Kuwait University Hospital for medical students.[

When Sana'a university was first established, it had two faculties: the Faculty of Sharia and Law and the Faculty of Education, which also included the specialties of Colleges of Arts, Sciences and Education. In 1974, those specialties were developed and formed three new faculties: Arts, Science, Education. The Faculty of Sharia and Law celebrated the launch of the Business Department, which became an independent faculty a year later. By that time, the university included five faculties and continued expansion until it included the rest of the other specialties. As of 2005, Sana'a University was composed of twenty faculties with 12 faculties at the main campus of Sanaa and eight others at different branches throughout the country.
The university started postgraduate studies at the start of the 1980s

موقع الشلال:
يقع شلال المشنة في سفح جبل بعدان في نطاق مديرية المشنة وفي الجهة الشرقية من مدينة إب (مركز المحافظة)، وتغذيه ينابيع جبل بعدان بالمياه العذبة طوال العام، وتحيط به خضرة الجبال وجمال مدينة إب الآسرة.
مميزات الشلال:
* يعتبر الشلال من أجمل المواقع السياحية في محافظة إب، حيث يتميز بمناظره الطبيعية الخلابة وهدير الماء المتدفق من ارتفاع شاهق.

* يقصده المئات من الزائرين من أبناء المحافظة وزوارها، طوال أيام العام، وفي موسم الأمطار بشكل خاص يتحول المكان إلى مزار مكتظ بالزائرين.
* يوفر الشلال للزائرين فرصة الاستمتاع بمناظره الطبيعية الخلابة، والاسترخاء على أصوات هدير الماء، وممارسة الأنشطة الترفيهية المختلفة مثل التنزه والمشي والتخييم.
* يعتبر الشلال مصدر رزق للعشرات من السكان المحليين، حيث تنتشر في محيطه العديد من الأكشاك والمحلات التي تبيع المأكولات والمشروبات والهدايا التذكارية.
كيف تصل إلى شلال المشنه:
يمكن الوصول إلى شلال المشنة من مدينة إب بسهولة، حيث يبعد عنها حوالي 15 كيلومترًا. يمكن الوصول إلى الشلال بالسيارة أو الدراجة النارية أو الحافلة.
نصائح عند زيارة شلال المشنه:
* احرص على ارتداء ملابس وأحذية مريحة مناسبة للمشي.
* خذ معك قبعة ونظارات شمسية، خاصة في فصل الصيف.
* احمل معك كمية كافية من الماء والوجبات الخفيفة.
* احترم البيئة الطبيعية للمنطقة، ولا تترك وراءك أي نفايات.
معلومات إضافية:
* أفضل وقت لزيارة شلال المشنة هو في فصل الربيع أو الخريف، حيث تكون درجات الحرارة معتدلة والأجواء جميلة.
* يوجد في محيط الشلال العديد من المطاعم والمقاهي التي تقدم المأكولات والمشروبات اليمنية التقليدية.
* يمكنك الاستمتاع برحلة إلى الشلال مع أحد المرشدين السياحيين المحليين، الذين سيطلعونك على تاريخ المنطقة ومعالمها.","Images":null,"When":"a year ago","review_id":"Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21wd2JrTmFhSFYwYVhsd2JYVlNRMmhaU2s4M1NYYxAB","source":"Google","rating_scale":5,"rating_float":5,"author_url":"https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/113677349063971097865/reviews?hl=en-US","posted_at_unix_micros":1750768857318951,"updated_at_unix_micros":1750768857318951,"language":"ar","translated_lang":"en","text_original":"شلال المشنه في محافظة إب الجمهورية اليمنية:

Location of the Waterfall:

Al-Mashna Waterfall is located at the foot of Mount Ba'dan, within the Al-Mashna District, east of Ibb City (the governorate's capital). It is fed by the springs of Mount Ba'dan, which provide fresh water year-round, and is surrounded by the lush greenery of the mountains and the captivating beauty of Ibb City.

Features of the Waterfall:

* The waterfall is considered one of the most beautiful tourist sites in Ibb Governorate, distinguished by its breathtaking natural scenery and the roar of the water cascading from a great height.

* Hundreds of visitors from within the governorate and beyond frequent the waterfall throughout the year. During the rainy season, the area becomes particularly crowded.

* The waterfall offers visitors the opportunity to enjoy its stunning natural scenery, relax to the sounds of the rushing water, and engage in various recreational activities such as hiking, walking, and camping.

يعتبر المستشفى إضافة نوعية للخدمات الصحية 💊 في تعز، وخطوة هامة نحو تحسين جودة الرعاية الطبية في المناطق المحرومة وقد تم تجهيزيه بكافة الاجهزة الطبية والمكتبية.

It is located in Sana'a, the capital of Yemen, and is currently organized with 17 faculties. Previously the university was located at 15°20′53.16″N 44°11′26.83″E, and was built on the grounds of the old Jewish cemetery.

The university includes several accommodation buildings for staff and students and is partnered with the Kuwait University Hospital for medical students.[

When Sana'a university was first established, it had two faculties: the Faculty of Sharia and Law and the Faculty of Education, which also included the specialties of Colleges of Arts, Sciences and Education. In 1974, those specialties were developed and formed three new faculties: Arts, Science, Education. The Faculty of Sharia and Law celebrated the launch of the Business Department, which became an independent faculty a year later. By that time, the university included five faculties and continued expansion until it included the rest of the other specialties. As of 2005, Sana'a University was composed of twenty faculties with 12 faculties at the main campus of Sanaa and eight others at different branches throughout the country.
The university started postgraduate studies at the start of the 1980s
